{{Top|leg}}
'''Joventusek''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Caarimon]]. Its name was the [[Caarimala]] word for "gateway" and all [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that arrived on Caarimon had to pass through the city. Like all Caarimon cities, it floated just above the surface of the planet and was powered by the byproducts of [[Buehl grass]]

The [[Metatheran Cartel]] had some offices in Joventusek, which they named [[Cartel Central]].
